item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\ncases=[\\n ({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{'ignored':['b']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'same','timestamp':1,'meta':{'b':2,'a':1}}},'current':{'x':{'meta':{'a':1,'b':2},'timestamp':2,'name':'same','kind':'file'}}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','v':1}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','v':1},'z':{'kind':'file','v':2}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n]\\nfor req,pol,want in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)\\n got=evaluate(req,pol)\\n assert got==want,(got,want)\\n assert req==rb and pol==pb\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json'))\\npolicy=json.load(open('policy.json'))\\nreport=json.load(open('report.json'))\\nassert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
